Game Overview

In Frost Leap, the core idea is straightforward: leap into Frost Leap's enchanting icy world where agility and strategic thinking are your best allies. Dodge hazards and conquer tricky levels with perfect timing and quick reflexes. Aim for the highest scores while mesmerizing winter visuals accompany you on this exhilarating adventure of jumps and daring maneuvers.
